MyECI: Moderation and Disposal of Inappropriate Content
TyCSubtitulo: EasyMeet is committed to maintaining a safe environment free of offensive or inappropriate content. To do this, we implement the following measures:
TyCP1.1: Users can report any content they consider inappropriate, offensive, violent, or that violates these terms.
TyCP1.2: Reports will be reviewed by our moderation team.
TyCP2.1: EasyMeet has a moderation team that will evaluate and take measures within a maximum period of 24 hours from receipt of the report.
TyCP2.2: If the reported content violates our policies, it will be removed immediately.
TyCP3.1: Users who post prohibited content will receive a warning.
TyCP3.2: In serious or repeat cases, the account may be suspended or deleted without prior notice.
TyCP3.3: EasyMeet reserves the right to notify the authorities in case of illegal content.
TyCP4: Commitment to the App Store Regulations:
TyCP4.1: EasyMeet complies with Apple guidelines, ensuring moderation and elimination of harmful content.
TyCP4.2: By using EasyMeet, users accept these rules and understand that failure to comply can result in loss of access to the application.
